data.name: Carboneers
data.description: Carboneers (formerly Dutch Carboneers) is a Netherlands-based biochar CDR developer that partners with smallholder farming communities in India and Ghana to convert agricultural residues into biochar. The company issues carbon removal credits through the Isometric registry, working with partners such as Terrafront Ventures and Together for Restoration.
